visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing a black t-shirt and a black baseball cap backward walks confidently toward a large mirror in a clothing store. A woman in a black top and grey trousers stands behind him, pointing at his reflection with a smile. The background shows wooden flooring and racks of white t-shirts under bright studio lighting. (2) The camera zooms in on the boy's face; he looks around the store with wide eyes, holding a small tan leather handbag. In the background, two women are visible holding coffee cups, one wearing a plaid shirt and the other in a black t-shirt. (3) The boy begins walking down the center aisle as if it were a runway, swaying slightly while maintaining his grip on the tan bag. Rows of colorful sneakers are displayed on backlit wall shelves to his left, and black benches are placed along the walkway. (4) The boy stops and tilts his head playfully towards the camera while continuing to hold the tan bag. A woman's hand enters the frame from the right to gently hold his left hand, guiding him forward. The setting remains the brightly lit retail space with polished grey floors. (5) The boy continues his 'walk' from a lower camera angle, looking directly at the lens. He passes a black Adidas display unit. The lighting is high-contrast, emphasizing his facial features and the textures of his clothing. (6) Two women stand near a clothing rack; the woman in the plaid shirt points at a price tag on a small black bag while holding a Starbucks cup. The other woman smiles and watches. The background is filled with various garments on hangers. (7) The boy is shown running energetically through the store, his small tan bag swinging as he moves. He disappears behind a clothing rack as the camera follows his quick movements. The environment is vibrant and busy with shoppers. (8) In the final scene, the boy is seen holding his mother's hand while carrying a small blue and white Adidas paper shopping bag. He looks up at her as they walk toward the exit. Large white text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen.
